entities.summary: Anon Uchenna Nwosu Jr. is an American professional football linebacker for the Seattle Seahawks of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the USC Trojans, and was selected by the Los Angeles Chargers in the second round of the 2018 NFL draft.
